description: One case per toggle: the estate with entitiesWithoutDeadLetterAlert on and nothing else. The known answer is F-DLQ-ALERT, the Finding of Check DLQ-ALERT, whose severity (High) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: entitiesWithoutDeadLetterAlert, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.sh fixed, then infra/as-found.sh entitiesWithoutDeadLetterAlert=carrier-tracking
setup.note: if a run or message also failed, the Finding that pairs the failure with the missing alert may join; the case allows it

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: A dead-letter queue has no alert. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
